{{Quote|The Incom T-65 X-wing is the fighter that killed the Death Star. An almost perfect balance of speed, maneuverability, and defensive shielding make it the fighter of choice for Rogue Squadron.|General Carlist Rieekan|<ref name="Rogue Squadron video game">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>}}
The '''X-wing''' was a prominent series of multiple [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] produced by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] with a characteristic "X" shape of four wings, known as [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]], extending out from the fuselage. These starfighters were found in the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], as well as the [[New Jedi Order]]. The X-wing was originally developed for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but the entire Incom design team defected with the prototypes to the Rebel Alliance, ending the contract.

==Behind the scenes==
The X-wing fighters were originally colored blue, but were changed to red and white because the blue color blended in with the blue-screen during filming. In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization of ''A New Hope'']], the X-wing squadron is called Blue Wing, and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] callsign was Blue Four.
